name: cbt-rsms
description: Sistem Ujian Online CBT RSMS - Computer Based Test

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend-bk" "npm run dev:frontend-bk"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=frontend-bk
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend-bk && npm install --workspace=frontend-bk
scripts.start:pm2: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
